scale.note: Scored critically: 3 means meets, 4 is strong, 5 is kept for areas where the candidate is exceptional.

criteria.label: Relevant industry experience and insight
criteria.description: B2B software sold to finance teams. 3: has sold software to mid-market buyers. 5: has sold to CFOs and finance teams and knows how they buy.

criteria.label: Building and leading a sales team
criteria.description: Hiring and leading 15 to 25 sellers across new business and account management. 3: has led a team of that size. 5: has built one from a small base through a growth phase, with leaders who were promoted.

criteria.label: Owning the revenue plan
criteria.description: Setting and hitting the number. 3: has owned a revenue target and forecast. 5: has owned the company plan and beaten it repeatedly, with figures in the record.

criteria.label: Scaling and growth experience
criteria.description: Growth stage, venture or private equity backed. 3: has worked in a company at this stage. 5: has scaled revenue through a funding round or a growth plan more than once.

criteria.label: Sales process and systems
criteria.description: Pipeline discipline, forecasting, CRM and enablement. 3: has run a clear sales process. 5: built the process and systems others still use.

criteria.label: CEO partnership and commercial acumen
criteria.description: Reporting to the CEO and working with the board on the plan. 3: has reported to a CEO or GM. 5: a trusted partner to the CEO and board, with notes or record that show it.

criteria.label: Account management and expansion
criteria.description: Keeping and growing existing customers. 3: has led account management or renewals. 5: drove measured expansion revenue and retention.

criteria.label: Location, relocation or commuting
criteria.description: Based in Washington, DC, about 30 percent travel. 3: in the region or open to relocate, travel fine. 5: in the region and has done this level of travel before.

criteria.label: Ability to be the face in the market
criteria.description: Representing the company with customers, partners and at events. 3: has represented the company with key customers. 5: a known voice in the market, speaking or partner-facing.

recommendation.meaning: yes: worth a recruiter conversation for this search. no: not for this search.

industry.direct: B2B software sold to finance or accounting teams.
industry.adjacent: Other B2B software, fintech, or financial services technology.
